channel.title: DJWEIRDNASTY News
channel.description: Latest national, entertainment, music, and sports news from DJWEIRDNASTY.

item.title: Mississippi Police Chief Fired Amid Racist Text Scandal After 1-Year-Old Is Killed in Police Shooting
item.description: A Mississippi police department is facing another leadership change after Police Chief Harold “Hal” Vanderford was fired amid allegations that he repeatedly used racist slurs in private text messages.

item.title: Uber Leaves Nigeria After 12 Years as Costs, Competition and Corporate Changes Reshape Ride-Hailing
item.description: Uber has stopped accepting ride requests in Nigeria and Uganda, ending a 12-year run in one of Africa's largest transportation markets as rising costs and global restructuring reshape its operations.

item.title: Tampa Rapper Convicted of Killing Pregnant Woman and Her Unborn Child, Faces Death Penalty Phase
item.description: A Tampa jury has found rapper Billy Adams III guilty of murdering 22-year-old Alana Sims and her unborn child. The case now moves to a death penalty sentencing phase.

item.title: $15 Nail Repair Dispute Turns Into Gunfire at Phoenix Salon, Police Say
item.description: A dispute over a $15 nail repair allegedly escalated into gunfire at a Phoenix salon, sending nearly two dozen people scrambling for safety, authorities said.

item.title: Indiana Woman Charged After Fatal Fort Wayne Hit-and-Run Investigation Leads Police to Red Ford F-150
item.description: Investigators say a DoorDash driver was behind the wheel when a pedestrian was fatally struck. Months later, police say vehicle evidence, surveillance footage and witness information helped identify a suspect.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: The $1 Million Music Video Is Losing Its Place in the Music Industry
item.description: Record labels aren’t abandoning visual storytelling. They’re changing what they believe a music video is supposed to accomplish.

item.title: William Jewell Football Player MicahJo Barnett Dies After Medical Emergency During Season Opener
item.description: William Jewell College is mourning the death of junior running back MicahJo Barnett, who died Saturday after suffering a medical emergency during the Cardinals’ season-opening football game in Liberty, Missouri.

item.title: Georgia Teen Sentenced to Life After Killing Mother Instead of Carrying Out Planned School Attack
item.description: A Georgia teenager who prosecutors say had been considering a mass shooting at her former middle school instead killed her mother in 2024. Nearly two years later, the girl, now 16, has been sentenced to life in prison.

item.title: Philadelphia Officer Placed on Leave After Man Dies in Hit-and-Run Following Police Encounter
item.description: A Philadelphia police officer has been placed on administrative leave after investigators determined that the officer encountered a man lying in a roadway shortly before the man was struck and fatally injured by a hit-and-run driver.

item.title: Wynonna Judd’s Daughter Grace Kelley Remains in Custody as Judge Rejects Request to Leave Jail for Birth
item.description: Grace Pauline Kelley, the daughter of country music star Wynonna Judd, was denied a temporary release from jail to give birth to her second child, according to recently surfaced court records.

item.title: Khalid Sheikh Mohammed Set for 2028 Trial in Long-Running 9/11 Case
item.description: More than two decades after the September 11 terrorist attacks, the U.S. military has set a new trial date for Khalid Sheikh Mohammed, the alleged principal planner of the attacks.

item.title: Former Chick-fil-A Worker Sentenced After $80,000 Mac and Cheese Refund Scheme
item.description: A former Chick-fil-A employee in Texas has been sentenced to prison after investigators said he exploited the restaurant's point-of-sale system to generate hundreds of fraudulent refunds totaling more than $80,000.

item.title: 14-Year-Old Girl Killed While Filming TikTok Videos; Teen Charged in Washington, D.C. Shooting
item.description: A 14-year-old Washington, D.C., girl was fatally shot while spending time with other teenagers and recording TikTok videos, and authorities now allege that a boy who was with her pulled the trigger.

item.title: Packers RB Josh Jacobs Faces Two Misdemeanor Charges After May Incident
item.description: Green Bay Packers running back Josh Jacobs is facing two misdemeanor criminal charges stemming from an alleged confrontation with his girlfriend at his Wisconsin home in May.

item.title: Himalayan Disaster Unleashes Deadly Floods as Glacier Collapse Ravages Nepal-Tibet Border
item.description: A catastrophic glacier collapse on the Nepal-Tibet border has left hundreds dead and over 1,300 missing as debris-filled floods ravage Himalayan communities.

item.title: ICE Awards $16.7 Million Contract for Electric Shock Gloves Amid Growing Concerns Over Use of Force
item.description: ICE has awarded a $16.7 million contract for 6,000 electric shock gloves, drawing sharp criticism from lawmakers and civil rights advocates over use of force concerns.

item.title: Lana Condor Opens the Door to a Jubilee Comeback as Marvel Builds Its Next X-Men Team
item.description: Lana Condor has reached out to Marvel about returning as Jubilee in the upcoming X-Men reboot, as the studio builds its new mutant team for 2028.

item.title: Demon Hunter Sues Netflix Over 'KPop Demon Hunters' Branding, Alleging Trademark Confusion
item.description: Christian metal band Demon Hunter has filed a federal trademark lawsuit against Netflix over its 'KPop Demon Hunters' franchise, citing consumer confusion in music, merchandise and live entertainment.

item.title: Tim Curry, 'Rocky Horror Picture Show' and 'It' Icon, Dies at 80
item.description: Tim Curry, the acclaimed British actor whose unforgettable performances in The Rocky Horror Picture Show, It, Clue and Home Alone 2 made him one of the most recognizable performers of his generation, has died at 80.

item.title: Federal Judge Strikes Down Texas Drag Show Law Again, Citing First Amendment Concerns
item.description: A federal judge has once again ruled against a Texas law restricting drag performances, concluding that the statute violates the First Amendment and is written too broadly.

item.title: Meta Agrees to $17 Billion Settlement With States Over Alleged Harm to Children
item.description: Meta has agreed to a proposed settlement worth up to $17 billion with dozens of U.S. states over allegations that Facebook and Instagram were deliberately designed to encourage excessive use among children and teenagers.

item.title: FBI Takes Down Network Accused of Helping Chinese Hackers Target U.S. Systems
item.description: Federal authorities have moved to disrupt a sophisticated cyber infrastructure allegedly used by Chinese state-backed hackers to conduct operations against U.S. government agencies, critical infrastructure and major private-sector organizations.

item.title: FDA Approves Rasonque, Opening a New Treatment Era for Advanced Pancreatic Cancer
item.description: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved Rasonque, a new oral cancer treatment that could significantly change the way advanced pancreatic cancer is treated after previous therapies stop working.

item.title: Florida Officer Accused of Repeatedly Tracking Estranged Wife Through License Plate Cameras
item.description: A Florida police officer is accused of using the department's Flock Safety license plate reader system to track his estranged wife's vehicle more than 700 times over nearly two years.

item.title: Judge Denies Karmelo Anthony's Request for New Trial in Austin Metcalf Stabbing Case
item.description: A Texas judge has rejected Karmelo Anthony's request for a new trial, leaving his murder conviction and 35-year prison sentence intact while his defense prepares an appeal.

item.title: Lil Yachty's WWE Debut Draws Fan Backlash as Rapper Prepares for Five-Minute Match With Baron Corbin
item.description: Lil Yachty is preparing to make his WWE in-ring debut against Baron Corbin at Sunday Night's Main Event on Sept. 6 in Atlanta.

item.title: 35-Year-Old Man Killed in Early-Morning Kensington Shooting as Philadelphia Police Search for Suspect
item.description: A 35-year-old man was fatally shot early Sunday morning in Philadelphia's Kensington neighborhood. Police are searching for a suspect.

item.title: Ohio Doctor Who Studied Adolescent Homicide Killed in Alleged Plot Involving Her Daughter
item.description: An Ohio physician whose academic work examined adolescent homicide was fatally shot inside her home. Investigators allege her 18-year-old daughter helped plan the killing.

item.title: Connecticut Man Missed $5.8 Million Lottery Jackpot After Discovering Winning Ticket Too Late
item.description: Clarence Jackson, a Connecticut man, discovered he had a $5.8 million winning lottery ticket on the very last day to claim it — but circumstances prevented him from collecting.

item.title: Arkansas Woman Sentenced to 20 Years After Shooting Ex-Boyfriend 17 Times
item.description: Rebecca Jane Mryglod, 38, has been sentenced to 20 years in an Arkansas state prison after admitting that she shot her former boyfriend 17 times inside his home.
